requires.why: v2.8 10 D gate: a story with no briefing gets a per-chat draft in the open briefing page, and a draft naming a later beat is thrown away. The draft is planted (storyOrchestratorDebugBriefingResponse), so no model is called; the real-model floors are the CL row.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugBriefingResponse = JSON.stringify({ sections: [{ heading: 'Where you are', text: 'The Hall, at night.' }, { heading: 'How to play', text: 'Write what you do and say.' }] }); return true;

import_story.title: SO-V28-10 Brief
import_story.player_intro: You arrive at the hall at night.

qualities.rubric: Does the player know who the traitor is?

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const until = Date.now() + 15000; while (rt.getSnapshot().briefing?.view?.source !== 'draft' && Date.now() < until) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const view = rt.getSnapshot().briefing?.view; if (view?.source !== 'draft') throw new Error('no draft landed: ' + JSON.stringify(view)); const until2 = Date.now() + 5000; while (!document.querySelector('#so-briefing [data-so="briefing-drafted"]') && Date.now() < until2) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); const page = document.querySelector('#so-briefing')?.textContent ?? ''; if (!page.includes('The Hall, at night.')) throw new Error('the open page does not show the draft: ' + page.slice(0, 200)); if (/Corvin|AUTHOR-ONLY|vault-internal/.test(JSON.stringify(view) + page)) throw new Error('spoiler on the page'); return { sections: view.sections.length, note: Boolean(document.querySelector('#so-briefing [data-so="briefing-drafted"]')) };

globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugBriefingResponse = JSON.stringify({ sections: [{ heading: 'Ahead', text: 'The Vault of Corvin waits.' }] }); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (!(await rt.restartStory(true))) throw new Error('restart refused'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); const view = rt.getSnapshot().briefing?.view; if (view?.source !== 'intro') throw new Error('a spoiling draft was kept: ' + JSON.stringify(view)); return { source: view.source };
